text: This report includes several detailed appendices that provide a full financial summary of all program areas of Exhibition Place for the first quarter of 2018.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix E to the report (May 16, 2018) remain confidential in their entirety and not be released publicly as they pertain to the security of the property of the Board.
